verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions Salesforce APIs only in general terms ('Discover Salesforce APIs & put them to work'). It contains nothing on API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The axis clearly applies to a SaaS CRM platform, so lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
